MountAIn Ready — Evaluate edge AI hardware on real models Technology Products MountAIn Ready MountAIn Onboard IBEX by MountAIn EAP News Talk to us IBEX by MountAIn MountAIn Ready Your silicon  is not the bottleneck. MountAIn Ready optimises the model path before the backend compiler sees it, so developers can evaluate a target against a real workload without beginning with months of hardware-specific integration. Evaluate one model and one target Make capability easier to prove Edge-AI hardware can be powerful and still be difficult for developers to adopt. A model may exceed the practical memory envelope. The surrounding processing may not fit. Toolchain hand-offs introduce friction. A promising evaluation turns into a specialist engineering project before the target has earned its place in the design. Ready makes the first question simpler: can this model become a credible application on this target? What Ready does Evidence developers and ecosystems can act on. 01 Starts from the developer’s model Bring a trained model and a defined task rather than relying on a generic score that may not resemble the intended application. 02 Makes the target constraints visible Assess the model in the context of memory, processing stages and the selected hardware path. 03 Prepares the graph for the backend Optimise before the target compiler, while preserving the existing vendor toolchain and route to deployment. 04 Produces evidence people can act on Show the conditions behind the result so developers, product teams and ecosystem partners can judge relevance for themselves. For hardware ecosystems Move from AI support to credible evaluation. Ready helps a silicon or module provider move from “our device supports AI” to a more useful proposition: here is how a real model maps to the target, what the constraints are and what the developer should do next. ‍ More credible evaluation journeys Better technical conversations with developers and field teams Reproducible model-to-target evidence A clearer path from interest to design consideration How an evaluation works 01 Define One model, task and success condition. 02 Select Confirm target and toolchain. 03 Review Expose compatibility and constraints. 04 Reproduce Reproduce an agreed result before moving towards integration. For developers Ready reduces the cost of discovering whether a target is viable. You can begin with the model and success condition you already understand, then see how the hardware changes the deployment problem before making a deeper commitment. MountAIn Onboard — Deploy AI on your existing hardware Technology Products MountAIn Ready MountAIn Onboard IBEX by MountAIn EAP News Talk to us IBEX by MountAIn MountAIn Onboard The NPU is in your Camera . The AI application isn't. MountAIn Onboard helps teams deploy trained models inside an existing hardware and software stack. Keep the board, sensors and product architecture that are already decided. Resolve the model, memory and integration work that stands between them and useful on-device intelligence. Review your existing platform When hardware is no longer a choice Many product teams do not begin with a blank sheet. The board has been selected. The device is in market or close to it. Sensors, firmware, security and manufacturing decisions are already connected to the platform. Replacing the hardware to accommodate a model creates cost, delay and product risk. Onboard starts from the platform as it is. What Onboard does AI integration inside the selected envelope. 01 Works inside the selected envelope Assess the model against the memory, compute, power and software constraints of the existing product. 02 Optimises the application path Address the model together with the pre-processing, post-processing and data movement required by the use case. 03 Preserves the surrounding engineering Integrate through the target toolchain and product architecture instead of asking the team to rebuild around a new general-purpose platform. 03 Creates a route to validation Make assumptions, constraints and success criteria explicit so technical teams can test the result in the product context. A fit for product teams Onboard is designed for: Camera and imaging products Sensors and connected devices Equipment with an established embedded platform Teams replacing an underperforming or impractical AI approach Product lines that need a repeatable path across models or variants The engagement path 01 Define the product use case and the decision the model must support. 02 Review the model, target, memory envelope and current software path. 03 Identify the technical blockers and the smallest useful proof. 04 Optimise and integrate against agreed acceptance criteria. 05 Validate in the product environment before discussing production scope. What to bring and confidentiality A useful first conversation needs only: Do not send confidential files through the public form. A secure exchange can be arranged after the initial review. ‍ The model or model family The selected hardware and toolchain The relevant sensors or input path The product constraint that is blocking progress A measurable success condition Built on MountAIn Core Onboard applies the shared MountAIn workflow, compiler and middleware to a fixed product platform. The product route is integration; Core is the foundation underneath it.
